source: Whatever event you pass to a handler must match {0}. Register your event's type in the {1} registry in {2}, which is what {3} and {4} resolve to. If your own event object isn't web-shaped, pass handlers a web-shaped view of it. To give app code your own event instead, set it as {5} on the event you pass the {6}renderer{/6}.
